text: G1 review follow-ups folded into G2 (lead, 2026-09-26): (4) RecordIdentityCodecs.scala:48 accepts non-integers ({"data-record":7214.0} and 7.214e3 both decode), contradicting its scaladoc; refuse a non-integer JSON number and add a refusal test. (5) Qualify RecordLines' claim to be total over the text: a trailing "" after the last LF isn't a record, so owner(lastLine) is LineBeyond; pin that edge. (6) Rule 8: the LF-only line convention lives in a comment; name it in a type (e.g. a LineBreak.LfOnly policy or an LfLine name), and document that Studio must derive line numbers from RecordLines, never split the text itself (Java lines() and editors treat a lone CR as a break). (7) Tell Studio: owner(line) returns RecordRole without an offset (offset = line - span.first), and the lookup is named span, not lines as in the sketch. Also from G1: Diagnose instances for RecordIdentityError and CsvLayoutError.
